chainlink.sampling: 30 uniformly random priced dates per token, without replacement
chainlink.wrapper_proxies: WETH represents ETH and WBTC represents BTC; includes wrapper basis

limitations: Nearest quote within 12h of day end; see checkpoints for actual quote timestamps.
Price coverage is incomplete. No peg fills or derived wrapper prices.
Zero-address registry sentinels are retained as unpriced entries; DefiLlama native-coin aliases at zero are rejected.
Symbol rules express intended families and are not identity/backing verification.
WETH and WBTC are the Ethereum token proxies used for ETH/BTC validation.
Chainlink USDC/USD may cap upward deviations; this is an oracle comparison, not ground truth.
Reference follows the underlying asset: USD0 tracks USD; bUSD0 (formerly USD0++) tracks USD0, per https://docs.usual.money/resources-and-ecosystem/fact-sheets/usual-products/busd0.
Latest ERC20 metadata may differ from historical metadata.
Euler's eight external Uniswap v4 collateral wrappers resolve to an ERC721 position manager; a fungible token USD price cannot value individual NFT positions.
The existing vault AUM checkpoints contain aggregated monthly valuations, not reusable daily quote records.

stablecoins.sampling: Uniform without replacement over priced chain/token pairs with family usd_stable and reference USD; interest-bearing wrappers excluded

usage.journal_timing_note: utc records completion time. Concurrent responses can complete together; completion bursts do not measure request-start rate. Earlier requests have no recorded start timestamp.

preflight_api_probes.purpose: Chart API limit probes before script implementation; 1008 points, 1007 points, 300 points, 10 points, and 2 tokens times 300 points. Rejected queries exceeded the 500-point API limit.

usage.request_dispatch_policy: At least 0.26 seconds between DefiLlama request starts per process; one concurrent single-token chain check added one request
